newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 125,300 MT were 21 percent below the previous week, but exceeded the 4-week average by 35 percent. Major increases were for China (55,000 MT), Spain (18,000 MT), Mexico (16,700 MT), and the Philippines (16,500 MT).

Sales of 195,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily the result of increases for Taiwan (108,000 MT), China (105,000 MT, switched from Germany), and unknown destinations (85,100 MT) being partially offset by reductions of 105,000 MT for Germany.
Exports of 148,300 MT were 6 percent less than the previous week and the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Indonesia (58,000 MT), Mexico (43,800 MT), and Japan (17,200 MT).
